description: Phase B source-adapter expansion (ROADMAP.md Phase B; engine/docs/sources-genetic.md §DBpedia + Decision §2). Add a DBpedia `dbo:influencedBy` adapter for broader (noisier) INFLUENCED_BY / derivation coverage than the curated Wikidata statements the existing wikidata-sparql adapter yields. License-aware: DBpedia is CC-BY-SA 3.0, so the licence string must travel with each record as the Getty/Pleiades adapters do (contrast the CC0 Wikidata path). Ingest via SPARQL endpoint or RDF dump on top of the reusable dump adapter (106). Scope: the engine acquire layer + a DBpedia source spec mapping dbo:influencedBy -> INFLUENCED_BY + fixtures. Serializes with the other Phase-B adapters on the `acquire` domain.

userStories.title: DBpedia dbo:influencedBy -> INFLUENCED_BY ingest
userStories.description: Add a DBpedia adapter/spec that ingests dbo:influencedBy (and the narrow inspired-by form) into canonical INFLUENCED_BY edges, license-aware.
acceptanceCriteria: A DBpedia source (source.type: dump or a SPARQL-endpoint spec, reusing the 106 plumbing where applicable) ingests dbo:influencedBy statements into canonical INFLUENCED_BY edges, aligned with the same relation the wikidata-sparql adapter already emits (Wikidata P737).
Every emitted record carries the CC-BY-SA 3.0 licence string + DBpedia provenance, so share-alike attribution travels with the (noisier) coverage.
A hermetic test over a small DBpedia fixture (RDF/SPARQL-result) asserts the INFLUENCED_BY edges + licence; `uv run --all-packages pytest engine/tests` passes.

userStories.title: De-dupe against the curated Wikidata edges
userStories.description: Since DBpedia mirrors Wikipedia infoboxes it overlaps the curated Wikidata statements; ensure the broader DBpedia edges reconcile rather than duplicate.
acceptanceCriteria: DBpedia INFLUENCED_BY edges that duplicate an existing Wikidata-sourced edge reconcile (merge/dedupe with provenance retained) instead of creating parallel edges, covered by a test.
The engine gate is green: `uv run ruff check .` (engine) and `uv run mypy src` (engine).
`.chief/verify.sh` passes; the spec + fixture JSON parse.
